cannedComments.description: Local Sec. 58-228 (2) A certified food protection manager shall be scheduled and available to the food establishment or pop-up food vendor during all hours of operation as required in FDA Food Code, §2-101. 11 and §2-102.12 (EXECPT for establishments that handle only prepackaged food and do not package food, do not prepare or handle exposed Time/ Temperature Control for Safety( TCS), as defined by the FDA Food Code, or are a temporary food establishment)
